title: Haley L NDE 3778
content: My husband and I were in a car accident at around 9:30 pm on Sunday May 21, 2006. I was driving but luckily, I had my seatbelt on. My husband didn't. My truck went off the shoulder, I jerked it back onto the road and over corrected. It flipped onto the driver side and slid down the road. When it flipped, my husband fell into me, causing my head to slam into the road as we were sliding, knocking me unconscious. My left arm was also caught between the road and the truck. I drifted in and out of consciousness, remembering my husband said help was on the way. I couldn't move because my arm was trapped. Next thing I remember is a fireman calling my name telling me to hold on; they were going to use the Jaws of Life to get me out. I guess I was losing a huge amount of blood and they had called in a helicopter to take me to the hospital once I was freed. I lost consciousness again, then that's when it happened. I suddenly wasn't in the truck anymore. I was standing in the road, looking around, but I wasn't in my body. I glanced at the fireman around my truck; saw the lights from the ambulance, police cars. But all of it didn't matter to me for some odd reason. I felt another presence there that scared me, almost like it was calling for me to come toward it even though IT spoke no words. I didn't want to go to it. I started east down the road, in the direction that would take me home. I wasn't in my body or a car; I was just gliding down the road. I can't explain how that felt. I was going very fast and since I traveled this road for years I knew all the landmarks and remember passing them. The presence still kept wanting me to come back - now it was like a light, I could see it reflecting past me onto the road ahead. But I refused, I knew if I stopped and went back I would die, at least that is how I felt. Suddenly I was yanked from this and found myself in the helicopter on my way to the hospital.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described 'gliding' very fast down the road and being 'yanked' back.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'presence' that scared her, seemed to be calling her toward it without words; later 'it was like a light' reflecting onto the road.

environment.environment_other_detail: Standing in the road near the accident scene; saw ambulance/police lights; later saw light reflecting onto the road ahead.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt 'yanked' from the experience and found herself in the helicopter en route to the hospital.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car/truck accident with head impact, unconsciousness, arm trapped, and major blood loss; helicopter transport to hospital.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived an unidentified 'presence' calling her; she moved/glided rapidly down the road toward home; then was 'yanked' back and found herself in the helicopter.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE at accident scene followed by movement down the road (no tunnel) with a nonverbal presence/light calling her back; abrupt return to awareness in helicopter.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Instead of a tunnel/otherworldly realm, she experienced gliding rapidly along a familiar road toward home while sensing a nonverbal presence/light calling her back, then an abrupt 'yanked' return into the helicopter.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I suddenly wasn't in the truck anymore. I was standing in the road, looking around, but I wasn't in my body.”
